title: ITL: Interpretable Document Alignment with Structured Reference Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2608.27031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Measuring alignment between documents and structured reference frameworks requires identifying conceptual evidence distributed throughout the text and reporting it through measures that are quantitative, interpretable, and traceable. Many commonly used retrieval and classification approaches return either pairwise similarity scores or one or more class labels, whereas fewer methods provide concept-level scores that are directly traceable to the terminological evidence supporting them. We present \emph{Intelligent Target Locator} (ITL), a domain-agnostic and language-portable methodology that estimates the affinity between the textual units of a target document and the concepts defined in a \emph{Structured Reference Document} ($SRD$). translated_title: ITL：基于结构化参考框架的可解释文档对齐方法
translated_abstract: 测量文档与结构化参考框架之间的对齐程度，需要识别分布在文本中的概念证据，并通过定量、可解释和可追踪的度量来报告。许多常用的检索和分类方法要么返回成对相似度分数，要么返回一个或多个类别标签，而较少有方法提供概念级分数，这些分数能直接追溯到支持它们的术语证据。我们提出了“智能目标定位器”（ITL），这是一种领域无关且语言可移植的方法，用于估计目标文档的文本单元与结构化参考文档（SRD）中定义的概念之间的亲和度。ITL从SRD中诱导出基于独立术语、二元组、三元组和共现关系的概念特定术语轮廓。每个术语被赋予一个重要性权重，该权重结合了概念记忆。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ITL的领域无关、语言可移植的可解释文档对齐方法，通过从结构化参考框架中构建概念级术语轮廓并分配重要性权重，实现了对文档与概念之间对齐程度的定量、可追踪度量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ITL, a domain-agnostic and language-portable interpretable document alignment method that constructs concept-level terminological profiles from structured reference frameworks and assigns importance weights, enabling quantitative and traceable measurement of document-concept alignment.
